# Vendored frontend dependencies

These files are served locally so wbforms can start without contacting a
third-party CDN at runtime.

- `vue-3.4.27.esm-browser.prod.js`: Vue 3.4.27, MIT license.
- `pico-2.1.1.min.css`: Pico CSS 2.1.1, MIT license.

The corresponding license texts are stored next to the vendored files.
